name: io.github.socialgocompany/socialgo
description: The first MCP server for a Social Media Marketing (SMM) panel — let AI assistants search services and place SMM orders (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube followers, likes, views), including keyless guest checkout (buy without an account or API key).

environmentVariables.name: SOCIALGO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for account / reseller operations (balance, order history). Optional — guest checkout and catalog browsing work with no key.

environmentVariables.name: SOCIALGO_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: User bearer token (alias SOCIALGO_USER_TOKEN) for authenticated actions. Optional.

environmentVariables.name: SOCIALGO_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the SMM API v2 base URL. Defaults to the SocialGO public API.
